events.title: Our solo demo is ready and submitted to Steam
events.summary: Update — October 19: the free solo demo is now available. Download the free solo demo from the Hold My Cargo Steam page. Original devlog — October 17: The Hold My Cargo single-player demo is finished and has been submitted to Steam for review. We are aiming for October 19, in time for Steam Next Fest, subject to Steam approval. We will confirm here when the demo is live. Cargo you carry by hand Your cargo is a physical object.
